About.title: About Sri Lakshmi Ladies PG
About.subtitle: A premium living space designed for women who value comfort, safety, and community.
About.description: Located in the heart of Davangere, Sri Lakshmi Ladies PG offers fully furnished accommodation with modern amenities. We are dedicated to providing a safe, comfortable, and supportive environment for students and working professionals. Our facility features 24/7 security, CCTV surveillance, hygienic food, high-speed WiFi, and a welcoming community that makes you feel at home.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our PG accommodation.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out timings?
items.a: Check-in is from 10:00 AM onwards. Check-out is before 12:00 PM on the departure date. Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged with prior notice.
Family visitors are allowed during designated hours (9:00 AM to 7:00 PM) with prior registration at the reception. All visitors must provide valid ID proof.

items.q: What is the food menu like?
items.a: We serve 100% vegetarian, home-style meals. Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner are provided. Special dietary requirements can be accommodated.
The main gate closes at 9:30 PM. Residents can request late entry with prior intimation to the warden. 24/7 security ensures safe entry at all hours.
Rent is charged on a monthly basis, payable in advance by the 5th of every month. We accept UPI, bank transfer, and cash payments.
Yes, we have washing machines available for resident use. Laundry service can also be arranged at nominal charges.
